During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], [[Duros/Legends|Duros]] [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Cad Bane/Legends|Cad Bane]] utilized a '''[[Munificent-class star frigate/Legends|''Munificent''-class star frigate]]''' loaned to him by the [[Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation]] and the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]].

==History==
[[File:BanesMunificent-CoD.jpg|thumb|left|200px|Bane's borrowed frigate fleeing Devaron]]
This frigate participated in the [[Battle of Devaron/Legends|Battle of Devaron]], having several [[InterGalactic Banking Clan/Legends|Banking Clan]] [[Frigate/Legends|frigates]] escort it out of the system. The [[Resolute/Legends|''Resolute'']] then entered the system, where it and the other ships battled. Bane ordered his ship out of the battle zone and to jump to hyperspace. While leaving, one of the engines was destroyed by the opposing [[Cruiser/Legends|cruiser]]. His ship crippled, Bane ordered all memory systems erased, the self-destruct system started, all of the ship's controls transferred to Bane's [[Wrist link/Legends|wrist-com]] and the bridge to be defended. [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]], [[Ahsoka Tano/Legends|Ahsoka Tano]], and Captain [[Rex/Legends|Rex]] boarded the frigate to recover a [[Holocron/Legends|holocron]], stolen by Bane. Battle ensued in the ship's gun deck. Fuel cells were scattered and a battle droid accidentally shot one, triggering a fire that subsequently detonated the fuel supply. Rex, Skywalker, Tano and [[Denal/Legends|Denal]] sought to flee the doomed vessel aboard a [[Unidentified Sheathipede-class transport shuttle (Cad Bane's frigate)/Legends|Neimoidian shuttle]]; however, Denal and [[Koho/Legends|Koho]] were killed by Bane. The Duros donned Denal's armor and boarded the shuttle, seconds before his frigate exploded.
